proposal.diagnosis: The TX sends bits LSB first correctly, but the RX shifts data LSB-first into an array and later publishes the register as-is, yielding a bit-reversed byte. The RX must accumulate bits MSB-first (i.e., shift left and insert at LSB) so that the first received bit becomes bit 0 of the output byte. Additionally, the start-bit detection timing is one cycle early; it should sample the line at mid-bit after a half-bit delay to meet the independent peer's framing.
